basic_steps: Start in a proud, upright stance
Execute rhythmic stamps to establish the beat
Incorporate leg-slaps (slapping the thigh or boot) in sync with the music
Perform heel clicks while jumping or stepping
Improvise motifs based on the eight-measure musical phrasing
teaching.formation: Primarily solo; occasionally circle or semicircle
teaching.level_notes: Requires high physical stamina and a developed sense of rhythm for improvisation.
teaching.rhythm: Verbunkos style, often with sharp, syncopated accents

platform: Validated voice/movement feedback and accessible controls
Human BDF consent/matching, moderation and measured session synchronization
Tested camera/split-screen delivery; AR remains an optional future adapter
